withdrawal_confirmation.value: I have read and agree with the venue's withdrawal policy on behalf of myself and my co-authors.

comment.value: We identified significant flaws in the paper's experiments and are therefore withdrawing it for a detailed review. We strongly advise researchers to refrain from citing, using, or building upon the methods and code associated with this work. We plan to release a revised version on arXiv once our investigation is complete and the issues are resolved.
